name: Busto de Bureba (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, white and red with a yellow triangle at the hoist, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Busto de Bureba (a castle, a tree and a lake).
history: Municipal flag of Busto de Bureba; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: triangle with its base along the hoist
Busto de Bureba arms — castle, tree and lake
